science-source-y8-safety-bay-2024-energy.title: Year 8 Science — Energy — Safety Bay 2024 (original assessment)
science-source-y8-safety-bay-2024-energy.coverage: Original assessment MC and cyclist diagram. Every written calculation, flow diagram, efficiency and extended-response task is retained with created marking guidance in the bank.

questions.prompt: Which is the best definition of energy? The
options: amount of matter in an object.
questions.explanation: Learning Vault created — A. ability to do work.. Energy is the capacity to do work or produce change.

questions.prompt:
Sam is riding a bicycle along a path and discovered that it became harder to pedal when he arrived at a small hill. What type of energy did Sam use to power the bike?
[LV-MEDIA:{"images":[{"pack":"repo-science-batch08","id":"cyclist"}]}]
questions.explanation: Learning Vault created — C. Chemical Energy. Sam uses chemical energy from food to power muscle activity.

questions.prompt:
Sam is riding a bicycle along a path and discovered that it became harder to pedal when he arrived at a small hill. Which type of energy was NOT produced by Sam when riding the bike?
[LV-MEDIA:{"images":[{"pack":"repo-science-batch08","id":"cyclist"}]}]
questions.explanation: Learning Vault created — B. Light Energy. Light energy is not an intended output of the cyclist shown; kinetic, sound and thermal energy are produced.

questions.prompt:
Sam is riding a bicycle along a path and discovered that it became harder to pedal when he arrived at a small hill. Why was it harder for Sam to ride up the hill?
[LV-MEDIA:{"images":[{"pack":"repo-science-batch08","id":"cyclist"}]}]
options: Sam’s gravitational potential energy is increasing.
The pull of gravity on Sam is increasing
questions.explanation: Learning Vault created — A. Sam’s gravitational potential energy is increasing.. Riding uphill increases gravitational potential energy, requiring additional work against gravity.

questions.prompt: An example of a device that transforms chemical energy to electrical energy is a
questions.explanation: Learning Vault created — A. torch battery. A torch battery converts chemical energy to electrical energy.

questions.prompt: Which of the following does not influence the amount of gravitational potential energy an object has:
questions.explanation: Learning Vault created — B. velocity. Gravitational potential energy mgh depends on mass, gravitational field strength and height, not velocity.
Learning Vault created — C. Joules. The SI unit of energy is the joule (J).

questions.prompt: Which of the following devices converts gravitational potential energy to kinetic energy?
questions.explanation: Learning Vault created — B. Playground slide. Descending a playground slide converts gravitational potential energy to kinetic energy (with some thermal losses).

questions.prompt: Which type of energy is contained in food?
questions.explanation: Learning Vault created — A. Chemical. Food stores chemical energy.

questions.prompt: Which one of the following inventions converts sunlight energy into electricity?
questions.explanation: Learning Vault created — A. Photovoltaic cells.. Photovoltaic cells convert incident light energy to electrical energy.
